fields.label: 1. Household ID
fields.description: Generated automatically when the record is created; used to find this household again.

fields.label: 2. House No.
fields.description: Enter the official house number available. If no numbers are available please mention Not Applicable.

fields.label: 3. Address: Street Name, Road/Street Number, Slum Name
fields.description: Capture the address as accurately as possible to enable household identification and future verification visits. If the household is located in a slum, ensure the Slum Name is recorded correctly.

fields.label: 4. Landmark
fields.description: To capture a simple address with a landmark for revisiting the same Household.

fields.label: 5. Cluster name
fields.description: Select or record the official cluster name as per the project's cluster mapping list.

fields.label: 6. Municipal Corporation name
fields.description: Record the official name of the Municipal Corporation.

fields.label: 7. Zone name & number
fields.description: Record the official name of the Zone.

fields.label: 8. Circle name & number
fields.description: Record the official name of the Circle.

fields.label: 9. Ward name & number
fields.description: Record the official name of the Ward.

fields.label: 10. GPS location
fields.description: Capture the GPS location while standing near the household entrance. Ensure location services are enabled on the device and wait for an accurate GPS reading before saving.

fields.label: 11. Household status
fields.options:
Occupied
Vacant House
Door closed
Moved out
fields.description: If house is not occupied and permanently closed, end the household interview. If house is occupied but locked, end the household interview and come back to this house once you complete all the houses in that street.

fields.label: 12. Has the respondent given his/her consent for the survey?
fields.options:
Yes
No
Asked to revisit later
fields.description: Obtain the respondent's voluntary and informed consent before proceeding with the interview. Explain the purpose of the survey, how the information will be used, and assure confidentiality. The survey should only continue if consent is provided. Only if Yes are the rest of the questions asked; if the respondent does not consent, thank them and discontinue the survey.

fields.label: 13. Respondent's Name
fields.description: Always choose the respondent who is 18 years of age and above.

fields.label: 14. Respondent's relation to household head
fields.options:
Household head
Husband
Wife
Son
Daughter
Daughter-in-law
Son-in-law
Father
Mother
Others specify
fields.description: Identifies the respondent's relationship to the head of the household.

fields.label: 15. Contact Number of the HH
fields.description: Numerical; exactly 10 digits.

fields.label: 16. Household Roster
fields.description: Use the roster to capture all the household members' data (one row per member).

fields.label: No. of members staying in the family
fields.description: The rows of the household roster, counted automatically.

fields.label: 17. Language spoken in the family
fields.description: Identifies the primary language(s) commonly spoken by household members for daily communication.

fields.label: 18. Social status of the household
fields.options:
General
SC
ST
OBC
Not Applicable
Other (Specify)
fields.description: Identifies the household's social category as recognized for government records.

fields.label: 19. What type of house does the household reside in?
fields.options:
Pucca House
Semi-Pucca House
Kutcha House
Tin Sheet House
Tarpaulin/Plastic Sheet Shelter
Makeshift Hut/Shack
fields.description: Identifies the structural condition and construction material of the house, where the respondent is currently living. This information helps assess housing quality and living conditions.

fields.label: House located in
fields.description: Identifies the ownership status of the land on which the respondent's current house is located. This information helps understand land tenure and housing security.

fields.label: 20. House ownership status
fields.options:
Owned
Rented
Shared
Employer-provided
Encroached
Others specify
fields.description: Identifies the household's occupancy and ownership arrangement for the house, where the respondent currently resides. If Owned, continue with the ownership questions; if Rented, go directly to question 21.

fields.label: 20.1. Nature of ownership
fields.options:
Owned by the HH
Originally allotted by Govt (Government Housing Schemes)
Allotted to someone else but bought from them
Others, specify
fields.description: Identifies the source or basis of ownership of the house occupied by the respondent, helping to understand housing tenure and acquisition status.

fields.label: 20.2. Which house ownership documents do you have?
fields.options:
Patta/Title Deed
Registered Sale Deed
Government Allotment Letter
Property Tax Receipt
Municipal Assessment Record
Possession Certificate
Notary Agreement
None of the above
Others (Specify)
fields.description: Identifies the legal or supporting documents available with the household to establish ownership, possession, or occupancy rights. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 20.3. Duration of ownership
fields.options:
0-1 Years
1-3 years
3-5 years
5 years and above
fields.description: Identifies the duration of ownership of the house where the respondent is living, helping to understand housing stability and tenure history.

fields.label: 21. If rented, duration of residence as tenant
fields.options:
0-1 Years
1-3 years
3-5 years
5 years and above
fields.description: Identifies the length of time the household has been living in the current dwelling as a tenant.

fields.label: 22. Mention any other observations and details
fields.description: Record any additional observations about the household's housing condition, living environment, infrastructure and other relevant information: visible risks, overcrowding, accessibility issues, sanitation concerns or any unique circumstances.

fields.label: 23. Do you have electricity supply?
fields.description: Identifies whether the household has access to an electricity connection for domestic use.

fields.label: 23.1. Do you have electricity meters?
fields.description: Whether the household has an electricity meter installed for measuring and billing consumption.

fields.label: 23.2. Electricity meters registered for
fields.description: Whether the connection is registered exclusively for the household or shared with other households.

fields.label: 23.3. Do you access gruha jyothi scheme?
fields.description: Whether the household is enrolled in and currently receiving benefits under the Gruha Jyothi electricity subsidy scheme.

fields.label: 24. What is the alternate source of light in your house?
fields.options:
Earthen lamps
Kerosene lamps
Candles
Biomass/wood fires
Battery-powered torches
Solar lanterns
Others (Specify)
fields.description: The source of lighting used by the household when electricity is unavailable or not accessible.

fields.label: 25. Fuels used for cooking
fields.description: The fuel(s) the household uses for cooking food. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 26. Do you have a registered LPG (cooking gas) connection in your household?
fields.description: Whether the household has a valid LPG connection registered in the name of a household member.

fields.label: 26.2. Do you access Mahalakshmi scheme?
fields.description: Whether the household is enrolled in and receiving LPG subsidy benefits through the Mahalakshmi Scheme or the Direct Benefit Transfer for LPG (DBTL) programme.

fields.label: 27. Do you have water facility?
fields.description: Whether the household has access to a water supply for drinking and domestic use.

fields.label: 27.1. If Yes, what is the source for water?
fields.options:
Piped water connection (HH level taps)
Public Taps
Water Tanker
Borewell
Water Plants/ Treated Can Water
Other Specify
fields.description: The primary source from which the household obtains water for drinking and domestic use.

fields.label: 28. If No, what is the source of water?
fields.options:
Public Taps within 100mt distance
Public Taps between 100mt to 500mt distance
Public Taps beyond 500mt
Water Tanker within 500mt distance
Borewell between 500mt to 1000mt distance
fields.description: The alternative source from which the household collects water, including the distance travelled to access it.

fields.label: 29. Do you have drainage facility for your house?
fields.description: Availability of a drainage system for wastewater disposal.

fields.label: 30. Type of toilet facility used
fields.options:
At home
Public Toilet
Open defecation
fields.description: The usual toilet facility used by household members.

fields.label: 30.1. In case of public toilet, do you pay and use?
fields.description: Whether payment is required to use the public toilet.

fields.label: 32. How far is the Common Service Centre (CSC)/e-seva?
fields.options:
Within 1 Km
Above 2 Kms
Don't know
fields.description: Distance from the household to the nearest CSC/e-Seva/m-Seva centre.

fields.label: 33. Do you access Common Service Centres (CSCs)?
fields.description: Application assistance for schemes, grievance filing, documentation support.

fields.label: 34. Mention any other observations and details
35. Does any household member currently suffer from a chronic illness or long-term health condition?
fields.description: Whether any household member has a long-term or chronic health condition requiring ongoing care.

fields.label: 35.1. If yes, what are the major health conditions?
fields.options:
High Blood Pressure (BP)
Diabetes
Heart disease
Asthma / Respiratory illness
Kidney disease
Cancer
Other, specify
fields.description: Main chronic or long-term health conditions affecting household members. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 36. Any family member with disabilities?
fields.description: Whether any member of the household has a physical, sensory, intellectual, or other disability.

fields.label: 37. Where does your household usually go for medical treatment?
fields.options:
Basthi Dawakhana
Government hospital / PHC / UPHC
Private hospital / Clinic
Other, specify
fields.description: The healthcare facility most commonly used by household members when they need medical care.

fields.label: 38. Approximately how far is the nearest healthcare facility from your household?
fields.options:
Within 500 metres
500 metres-1 km
1-3 km
3-5 km
More than 5 km
fields.description: Distance from the household to the nearest healthcare facility.

fields.label: 39. Approximately how much did your household spend on healthcare during the last 12 months?
fields.description: Total household expenditure on medical treatment and healthcare in the past 12 months.

fields.label: 40. Is any household member covered under a health insurance scheme?
fields.description: Whether any household member is enrolled in a health insurance scheme.

fields.label: 40.1. If yes, which scheme?
fields.options:
Telangana Aarogyasri
Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY)
Private health insurance
Employer-provided insurance
Other, specify
fields.description: Type of health insurance scheme covering household member(s).

fields.label: 41. If not covered, what are the main reasons
fields.options:
Not aware of available schemes
Lack of required documents
Not aware of the application process
Not eligible
Application pending
Difficulties in registration
Other, specify
fields.description: Main reasons for not being covered under any health insurance scheme. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 42. Is there any currently pregnant woman in your household?
fields.description: Whether any female household member is currently pregnant.

fields.label: 42.1. If yes, is she receiving regular pregnancy check-ups (ANC)?
fields.description: Frequency of pregnancy check-ups received by the pregnant woman.

fields.label: 42.2. Where does she access pregnancy and delivery-related healthcare services?
fields.options:
Government maternity hospital/ UPHC
Private hospital
Other, specify
fields.description: Primary facility used for pregnancy check-ups and childbirth services.

fields.label: 42.3. Does the mother receive post-delivery health check-ups (PNC)?
fields.description: Whether the mother receives health check-ups after childbirth.

fields.label: 43. How many children below five years are there in your household?
fields.description: Ask only if children below five years are present in the household.

fields.label: 44. Are all children receiving vaccinations and regular growth monitoring as per their age?
fields.options:
Both vaccination and growth monitoring
Vaccination only
Growth monitoring only
Neither
fields.description: Immunization and growth monitoring status of children in the household.

fields.label: 47. Has any child been identified with Severe Acute Malnutrition (SAM) or Moderate Acute Malnutrition (MAM)?
fields.options:
Yes, SAM
Yes, MAM
No
Don't know
fields.description: Nutritional status of children in the household based on identification by a health worker or healthcare provider.

fields.label: 49. Has any household member aged 30 years or above been diagnosed with high BP or diabetes (NCD)?
fields.description: Presence of High BP or Diabetes among household members aged 30 years and above.

fields.label: 50. If diagnosed, are they receiving regular treatment and medicines?
fields.description: Whether diagnosed household members receive treatment and medicines regularly.

fields.label: 51. During the last 12 months, has any household member needed medical treatment but been unable to access it?
fields.description: Whether any household member was unable to obtain needed medical care during the past 12 months.

fields.label: 51.1. If yes, what were the main reasons?
fields.options:
High cost of treatment
Cost of medicines
Distance to healthcare facilities
Lack of transportation
Non-availability of doctors or medicines
Work commitments / Loss of daily wages
Lack of awareness
Other, specify
fields.description: Main reasons for not being able to access needed medical treatment. More than one can be selected.

fields.label: 52. Overall observation on Health at the Household level
53. Overall Observations and General Remarks on the Household (HH)
fields.description: Summarize the overall living conditions, socio-economic status, key vulnerabilities, strengths, and any notable concerns of the household. Include observations related to housing, income, health, education, livelihood, access to basic services, and support systems. Mention any specific needs or risks identified during the assessment.

fields.label: 54. Number of Individual profiles captured are equal to the number of members in the household mentioned above
fields.description: Ticked automatically when the number of Individual profiles captured equals the number of members in the roster.

fields.label: 55-56. Status
fields.description: Documentation status (55) and validation status (56): the Community Volunteer sets Partially Completed or Completed; the Program Manager/Coordinator sets Revision Needed or Validated. Choose Revision Needed and refer to the comments when something must be corrected.

fields.label: Settlement
fields.description: The settlement this household belongs to (when it has been profiled).

fields.label: Partner Organization
fields.description: Filled in from the settlement or the signed-in worker.

fields.label: Organization Name
fields.description: Fetched from the Partner Details.

fields.label: Name of the ORW
fields.description: The staff member collecting this household's data. Filled in with the signed-in user when left empty.

fields.label: Date
fields.description: Defaults to today; change it to record a different date.
